name: io.github.rubatoyd/kosis-openapi-mcp
description: Korean official statistics (KOSIS) — tables, metadata and observations

environmentVariables.name: KOSIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: KOSIS OpenAPI key from kosis.kr (sign up, then request API access — auto-approved). Use the issued value verbatim; it looks like base64 but must not be decoded. Required.

environmentVariables.name: KOSIS_OS_TRUST
environmentVariables.description: Use the OS trust store for TLS (1=on, default). Set 0 to disable. Needed on school/corporate networks that intercept SSL.
